$comment: Contract for the CompleteRemediation server-side command (AD-003, command-concurrency skill). Deployed by plugins/deploy/Register-CompleteRemediation.ps1. Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_CompleteRemediation
customApi.description: Adviser marks a remediation action Completed (BR-006, BR-008, FR-020..FR-023). Enforces caller, transition, optimistic concurrency and idempotency, and writes an immutable Audit Event.

requestParameters.name: TargetId
requestParameters.description: Id of the al_remediationaction to complete.

requestParameters.name: ExpectedRowVersion
requestParameters.description: Row version the client read, for optimistic concurrency. Omit to skip the check.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay upserts the same Audit Event.

responseProperties.name: Status
responseProperties.description: The action status after the command (Completed).

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written for this command.

responseProperties.name: Conflict
responseProperties.description: True when the command was rejected for an optimistic-concurrency conflict.
